main_text.p: Unde manifestum est, Talmudicos con-stanter censuisse, lectionem à Mose scri-pto non esse traditam, quàm id, quod scri-ptum est à Mose, per traditionem à le-ctione distinguunt. Ita quod refertur Meghill. c. 1. f. 3. Nec unquam Talmudici Maforae contradicunt. Contradictio illa in Talmude nunquàm legitur, sed est in Scri-pturis recentiorum, Maforam cum Tal-mude comparantium. Sic dici possunt 70 Interpretes, Hieronymus, Aquila, Sym-machus, Onkelos, & Talmudi & Maforae contradicere. Priores Maforethas textū tantum recensuisse, hoc est קְרִי וּכְתִיב [?] plenas, deficientes, & abundantes dictio-nes, & ejusmodi quae litteras spectant adnotasse, autor est Elias Levita in ter-tia praefatione, sed non tam ipsum con-fidero, quàm rationem certissimam ab eo allatam. Maforethae illi erant Oc-cidentales, Judaico more, hoc est in Judaea, & eis Euphraten habitan-tes, postquam recensionem suam in lucem emiserunt, codicesque à se corre-ctos publicarunt, Orientales sive Baby-lonii

page.notes: The Hebrew phrase after "hoc est" is printed as "קרי וכתיב" with the vowel points shown; the exact pointing is hard to read at this scan resolution, so it is marked [?]. A small reference mark or sign follows "70" in the text; no matching note appears on this page. The catchword "lonii" is the start of the next line "Babylonii" split by the hyphen. The first line may continue from the previous page ("Unde"), so cont="true" is set. The text is set in roman type with italic words not clearly identifiable at this resolution, so no italics are marked.
